gsm_consumption: SELECT vendor, GREATEST(0, SUM(CASE WHEN weight_type='Starting Weight' THEN weight ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN weight_type='Ending Weight' THEN weight ELSE 0 END)) AS gsm_consumption_kg FROM gsm_usage_details {where_clause} GROUP BY vendor ORDER BY gsm_consumption_kg DESC
oee_percent: SELECT machine_id, machine_name, (((SUM(good_bags)/NULLIF(SUM(1)*60-SUM(downtime_mins),0))/NULLIF(AVG(target_speed),0)*100) * ((SUM(1)*60-SUM(downtime_mins))/NULLIF(SUM(1)*60,0)*100) * (CASE WHEN SUM(good_bags)=0 THEN 0 ELSE 100-((SUM(overlimit_count)+SUM(failed_bags))/NULLIF(SUM(good_bags),0))*100 END)) / 10000 AS oee_percent FROM oee_details_data {where_clause} GROUP BY machine_id, machine_name ORDER BY oee_percent DESC
ega_percent: SELECT machine_id, machine_name, ((SUM(t_weight)-SUM(theoretical_pack_weight))/NULLIF(SUM(t_weight),0))*100 AS ega_percent FROM ega_details_data {where_clause} GROUP BY machine_id, machine_name ORDER BY ega_percent DESC
quality_percent: SELECT machine_id, machine_name, CASE WHEN SUM(good_bags)=0 THEN 0 ELSE 100-((SUM(overlimit_count)+SUM(failed_bags))/NULLIF(SUM(good_bags),0))*100 END AS quality_percent FROM oee_details_data {where_clause} GROUP BY machine_id, machine_name ORDER BY quality_percent DESC
availability_percent: SELECT machine_id, machine_name, ((SUM(1)*60-SUM(downtime_mins))/NULLIF(SUM(1)*60,0))*100 AS availability_percent FROM oee_details_data {where_clause} GROUP BY machine_id, machine_name ORDER BY availability_percent DESC
production_kg: SELECT machine_id, machine_name, SUM(COALESCE(good_bags,0)*COALESCE(grammage,0))/1000 AS production_kg FROM oee_details_data {where_clause} GROUP BY machine_id, machine_name ORDER BY production_kg DESC
mttr: SELECT machine_id, machine_name, SUM(downtime_mins)/NULLIF(SUM(jaw_jam_error+jam_error+fmd_error+splice_error+dump_error+print_check_err+reg_mark_err),0) AS mttr_mins FROM oee_details_data {where_clause} GROUP BY machine_id, machine_name
mtbf: SELECT machine_id, machine_name, SUM(run_duration)/NULLIF(SUM(jaw_jam_error+jam_error+fmd_error+splice_error+dump_error+print_check_err+reg_mark_err),0) AS mtbf_mins FROM oee_details_data {where_clause} GROUP BY machine_id, machine_name
wastage_kg: SELECT plant_id, SUM(wastage_kg) AS wastage_kg FROM wastage_records {where_clause} GROUP BY plant_id ORDER BY wastage_kg DESC
total_downtime: SELECT machine_id, machine_name, SUM(downtime_mins) AS total_downtime_mins FROM oee_details_data {where_clause} GROUP BY machine_id, machine_name ORDER BY total_downtime_mins DESC
good_bags: SELECT machine_id, machine_name, SUM(good_bags) AS total_good_bags FROM oee_details_data {where_clause} GROUP BY machine_id, machine_name ORDER BY total_good_bags DESC
failed_bags: SELECT machine_id, machine_name, SUM(failed_bags) AS total_failed_bags FROM oee_details_data {where_clause} GROUP BY machine_id, machine_name ORDER BY total_failed_bags DESC
empty_bags: SELECT machine_id, machine_name, SUM(empty_bags) AS total_empty_bags FROM oee_details_data {where_clause} GROUP BY machine_id, machine_name ORDER BY total_empty_bags DESC
over_scale_count: SELECT machine_id, machine_name, SUM(over_scale) AS total_over_scale FROM ega_details_data {where_clause} GROUP BY machine_id, machine_name ORDER BY total_over_scale DESC
over_weight_count: SELECT machine_id, machine_name, SUM(over_weight) AS total_over_weight FROM ega_details_data {where_clause} GROUP BY machine_id, machine_name ORDER BY total_over_weight DESC
total_dumps: SELECT machine_id, machine_name, SUM(total_dumps) AS total_dumps FROM ega_details_data {where_clause} GROUP BY machine_id, machine_name ORDER BY total_dumps DESC
ega_grams: SELECT machine_id, machine_name, SUM(ega_gm) AS total_ega_gm FROM ega_details_data {where_clause} GROUP BY machine_id, machine_name ORDER BY total_ega_gm DESC
laminate_wastage: SELECT machine_id, machine_name, SUM(laminate_wastage) AS total_laminate_wastage FROM oee_details_data {where_clause} GROUP BY machine_id, machine_name ORDER BY total_laminate_wastage DESC
mean_weight: SELECT machine_id, machine_name, AVG(mean_weight) AS avg_mean_weight FROM ega_details_data {where_clause} GROUP BY machine_id, machine_name ORDER BY avg_mean_weight DESC
performance_percent: SELECT machine_id, machine_name, (SUM(good_bags) / NULLIF(SUM(1)*60 - SUM(downtime_mins),0)) / NULLIF(AVG(target_speed),0) * 100 AS performance_percent FROM oee_details_data {where_clause} GROUP BY machine_id, machine_name ORDER BY performance_percent DESC
production_speed_avg: SELECT machine_id, machine_name, AVG(speed.value::numeric) AS avg_speed_bpm FROM production_speed_details_data psd CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(psd.production_speed_bpm) AS speed(value) {where_clause} GROUP BY machine_id, machine_name ORDER BY avg_speed_bpm DESC
net_efficiency: SELECT machine_id, machine_name, (AVG(speed.value::numeric) / NULLIF(AVG(psd.target_speed), 0)) * 100 AS net_efficiency_percent FROM production_speed_details_data psd CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(psd.production_speed_bpm) AS speed(value) {where_clause} GROUP BY machine_id, machine_name ORDER BY net_efficiency_percent DESC
